summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K appending five Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns (the HK equivalent of an issuer repurchase report) covering October 26-30, 2026, recording daily on-market buybacks of its WVR ordinary shares (HKEX code 02423) made in the US. Reported repurchases span October 1-22, 2026 at prices of roughly USD 5.49 to 6.02 per share, in lots ranging from about 310,000 to 637,000 shares, with shares repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor is named; mechanics follow the issuer's existing buyback mandate. Watch pace of repurchases versus cancellation timing and any share-count overhang.
